text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Why are you apologizing? Trainer, you were 
marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You thought real hard about how to get it, 
and then tried out what you thought was 
the best way, right?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to learn through trial and 
error is amazing! So please, don't feel 
down."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
